name: Tom Yum Goong (Thai Hot and Sour Prawn Soup)
steps: Bring water to a simmer with the bruised lemongrass to make a fragrant broth.
Add the mushrooms and tomato and simmer for a few minutes until softened.
Add the raw prawns and simmer until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Stir in the coconut milk and fish sauce and warm through without boiling hard.
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice off the heat.
Ladle the soup into bowls and serve with steamed white rice.
